edr_agent_active_with_tamper_protection.title: EDR Agent Active With Tamper Protection
edr_agent_active_with_tamper_protection.description: Healthy EDR agent deployed on all inventoried endpoints with self/tamper protection that prevents disabling or uninstalling the agent (mitigates T1562.001 impair-defenses). Secure when true.

behavior_monitoring_enabled.title: Behavioral Monitoring Enabled
behavior_monitoring_enabled.description: Real-time behavioral/heuristic detection is enabled (not signature-only) so novel and fileless threats are caught by behavior. Secure when true.

realtime_protection_enabled.title: Real-Time Protection Enabled
realtime_protection_enabled.description: Real-time on-execution protection is active, scanning and blocking malicious code at the moment it runs. Secure when true.

ransomware_mass_change_detection_enabled.title: Ransomware Mass-Change Detection Enabled
ransomware_mass_change_detection_enabled.description: Behavioral anti-ransomware mass-change detection halts and isolates a host on detecting rapid bulk file modification/encryption (mitigates T1486). Secure when true.

endpoint_remediation_rollback_enabled.title: Endpoint Remediation / Rollback Enabled
endpoint_remediation_rollback_enabled.description: Remediation/rollback capability restores affected files to a known-good state after a ransomware or malware event. Secure when true.

automated_host_isolation_enabled.title: Automated Host Isolation Enabled
automated_host_isolation_enabled.description: Agent can automatically or via one-click isolate a host from the network on detection while preserving the management channel. Secure when true.

endpoint_containment_response_enabled.title: Endpoint Containment Response Enabled
endpoint_containment_response_enabled.description: Containment response workflow (kill process, quarantine file, terminate session) is available and enabled on detection. Secure when true.

application_allowlisting_enforced.title: Application Allowlisting Enforced
application_allowlisting_enforced.description: Application allowlisting / execution control restricts which code is permitted to run (M1038 execution prevention). Secure when true.

threat_signatures_current.title: Threat Detection Content Current
threat_signatures_current.description: Signature, engine, and threat-intel updates are pulled automatically on cadence so detection content stays current. Secure when true.

endpoint_audit_logs_centralised.title: Endpoint Telemetry Centralised
endpoint_audit_logs_centralised.description: EDR telemetry is centrally collected and forwarded to a SIEM for correlation and retention. Secure when true.

monitored_response_function_present.title: Monitored Response Function Present
monitored_response_function_present.description: A monitored response function (in-house SOC or MDR) triages and acts on detections under defined SLAs. Secure when true.
